name: Leonid Belkind
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Torq (AI SOC / security hyperautomation platform)
profile: Leonid Belkind co-founded Torq in 2020 with CEO Ofer Smadari and Chief Innovation Officer Eldad Livni and leads its technology. Torq began as a no-code security-automation platform and now sells an agentic 'AI SOC' platform; it raised a $140M Series D at a $1.2B valuation in January 2026, acquired Jit in May 2026 and unveiled its learning 'SOC Brain' at Black Hat 2026.
interesting_fact: Torq says it reached 430+ employees across the US, Canada, Israel and Europe with 300% year-over-year growth, and in March 2026 pitched its new agentic builder as 'the Cursor of Security Operations.'
deep_cut_fact: He writes as a contributing columnist for CEOWORLD magazine; his 2022 column argued that no-code automation is a way out of the cybersecurity staff-hiring crisis.
notes: Technical founder, publishes thought-leadership pieces - good fit for an AI/automation episode. Prior-career details not verified (search budget exhausted). 'Cursor of Security Operations' release: https://torq.io/news/agentic-builder/

name: Ma Yin
current_role: Co-founder and COO, QBoson (玻色量子, Beijing Bose Quantum Technology Co.)
profile: Ma Yin (马寅) co-founded QBoson in late 2020 in Beijing's Chaoyang district with CEO Dr. Wen Kai; the company builds special-purpose (coherent-photonic) quantum computers for optimisation and sampling problems, alongside a long-term general-purpose photonic programme. In May 2026 it launched its 'Yuliang Shanhai 1000' machine (up to 3,000 computing qubits in overclock mode) and its first general-purpose photonic quantum chip.
interesting_fact: QBoson says it built China's first special-purpose quantum-computer manufacturing plant in Shenzhen and runs photonic quantum labs in Suzhou, Shenzhen and Nanjing, targeting AI, drug discovery, embodied AI, brain-computer interfaces, energy and finance use cases.
notes: Operational co-founder; CEO Wen Kai (文凯) is the public/technical face. Energy angle: QBoson lists 'future energy' among application areas. Chinese-language outreach advisable.
